title: 🌺 Fey Flower Netherite Tools 🌺
description: A resoucepack that changes netherite tools to be visually belonging to a forest nymph.
body:
# Netherite Tools -> 🌺 Fey Flower Tools 🌺

A Minecraft resourcepack to make your netherite tools look like they came right from the fey wilds!

For all your cottage-core forest-nymph dreams!

### Description;

A resourcepack that changes netherite tools to be visually belonging to a forest nymph
![Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb0727eb4be020ee4ae3b4e2a87469687eb26f45.png)

### Other Info;

Dependencies-

No hard mod requirements.

No soft mod requirements.


Version-

Revision 0 - Minecraft 26.1+

My packs are default released for latest version of Minecraft- if you want it ported to a newer or older version let me know. _(*Done at my discretion. Some things may be too difficult to port.)_
